# A step with edits = False starts without --permission-mode, so the fake claude refuses its Write, as the real claude does in print mode.
cp flow/read-only.star edit-file
exec beehave run 7 --workflow flow/read-only.star
stdout 'item 7 finished'

grep -count=1 '^implement ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^refused edited.txt' refused.log
! exists edited.txt
